name: Financials
description: Standalone figures only, INR base units. FY2024 previous GAAP vs FY2025/26 Ind AS must be read with basis notes. Total debt includes current/noncurrent borrowings plus lease liabilities. Borrowing balances include accrued interest where source does. TNW deducts intangibles. No projected CMA actuals mixed in.
